explication: QRev is an AI-centered sales platform: users work through a web client to manage agents, campaigns, CRM records, and integrations, with app-server APIs providing those business capabilities. The documented architecture also includes a separate AI server and MongoDB/ChromaDB/SQL data technologies. Sampled sources establish the client routing, campaign and agent API dispatch, and server setup; most domain persistence and AI request wiring was not sampled, so those links are omitted or marked unverified.
